title: Clements
summary: Clements is a researcher working for the Huntik Foundation at his station in a secret Foundation base located within the Cathedral of Notre Dame. He was taken hostage by the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc, but was rescued by the Huntik team.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Clements' research within the Cathedral of Notre Dame has led to him coming into the possession of the [[Amulets]] of several [[Titans]] including [[Freelancer]], [[Hoplite]], and [[Ironsquire]]. {{source|The Legendary Titan of Fate}} He was later given charge over safeguarding and researching the [[Ring of Arc]]. {{source|Divide and Conquer}} When the Ring was taken out of the [[Reliquary]] for study and became active, Clements became trapped in a dreamlike state until [[Dante Vale|Dante Vale's]] [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team was able to free him. {{source|The Legendary Titan of Fate}}

Clements later joined the [[Huntik Foundation]] at the [[Spiral Mark]] during the final battle as part of the research team alongside [[Billie]] and [[Nasher]]. He analysed the Spiral energy while the others fought the [[Blood Spiral]]. {{Source|Lok and the Betrayer}} Following the defeat of [[the Betrayer]], Clements, [[Montehue]] and several other Foundation agents were stationed at the Spiral Mark to make sense of the data. Unbeknownst to them, the mark appeared to still be active and shone out across space to signal the return of the [[Nullifiers]]. {{Source|Dante's Return}}

full_text:
Clements is a researcher working for the Huntik Foundation at his station in a secret Foundation base located within the Cathedral of Notre Dame. He was taken hostage by the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc, but was rescued by the Huntik team.

History

Clements' research within the Cathedral of Notre Dame has led to him coming into the possession of the Amulets of several Titans including Freelancer, Hoplite, and Ironsquire. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] He was later given charge over safeguarding and researching the Ring of Arc. [Divide and Conquer] When the Ring was taken out of the Reliquary for study and became active, Clements became trapped in a dreamlike state until Dante Vale's Huntik team was able to free him. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

Clements later joined the Huntik Foundation at the Spiral Mark during the final battle as part of the research team alongside Billie and Nasher. He analysed the Spiral energy while the others fought the Blood Spiral. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, Clements, Montehue and several other Foundation agents were stationed at the Spiral Mark to make sense of the data. Unbeknownst to them, the mark appeared to still be active and shone out across space to signal the return of the Nullifiers. [Dante's Return]

Abilities

Clements is a highly skilled researcher whose specialty lies in the study of ancient relics and magical artefacts. He was not shown to possess any fighting skills, however his research has led him to come into the possession of several Amulets.

Bonded Titans

Freelancer — One of the Amulets on Clements' desk; it was temporarily turned against him by Arc but defeated by the Huntik team.

Hoplite — One of the Amulets on Clements' desk; it was temporarily turned against him by Arc but defeated by the Huntik team.

Ironsquire — One of the Amulets on Clements' desk; it was temporarily turned against him by Arc but defeated by the Huntik team..
